headlines.title: Shingles plummets among younger adults but is mysteriously rising in another group
headlines.description: Shingles is dropping among people who got chickenpox shots but mysteriously rising in people 35 and older, new research shows.

headlines.title: When teens get colorectal cancer, it’s often an aggressive form of the disease
headlines.description: Only a tiny number of colorectal cancer cases occur in people younger than 21, but they’re often diagnosed at later stages and more difficult to treat.

headlines.title: Med Student Recalls ‘Concerning’ First Signs of Leukemia Before Her Diagnosis at 22
headlines.description: Just a month after starting her first job out of college, she experienced scary symptoms that led to a cancer diagnosis and rare relapses.

headlines.title: This Doctor Soothes Patients by Performing Music on the Cello
headlines.description: Music is being used more as a complimentary treatment for everything from depression to cancer, and one doctor in California is seeing results while playing the instrument himself. Harry Smith returns to Sunday TODAY with a Sunday Spotlight on the doctor who soothes his ailing patients by playing the cello.

headlines.title: With more deaths than births in Ukraine, having babies becomes an act of national pride
headlines.description: With deaths outnumbering births in Ukraine by more than 3 to 1, having babies in a war-torn country becomes an act of national pride, and even survival. NBC News' Richard Engel reports from an underground bomb shelter turned delivery room.

headlines.title: Research shows colorectal cancer is on the rise for younger people and more severe
headlines.description: Jo Henderson was just 17-years-old when she was diagnosed with colorectal cancer. New research from Nationwide Children’s Hospital shows colorectal cancer cases are on the rise with more young people being diagnosed with severe cases. NBC News’ Erika Edwards reports.

headlines.title: Why Sharing Your Family's Health History With Doctor is Important
headlines.description: Knowing your family medical history is essential for understanding your health, so NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal stops by TODAY to share some helpful tips, including building a family health tree, asking your family questions, and more.

headlines.title: Save up to 50% on fall workout gear at Lululemon right now
headlines.description: Right now you can get up to 50% off on sports bras, leggings and shorts by shopping Lululemon’s “We Made Too Much” sale section.

headlines.title: These perfect-for-fall Adidas sneakers are 67% off right now
headlines.description: Adidas Women’s Handball Spezial Shoes are on sale at Dick’s Sporting Goods. The pink and navy pair is 67% off, bringing the price down to just $36.

headlines.title: New early October Prime Day deals just dropped — I hand-picked 57+ worth shopping (live updates)
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days is back October 6 to 7, but you can shop early deals today. Our editors are finding new discounts live from iRobot, Ninja, Lego and more.

headlines.title: When did Walmart’s clothes get this good? An editor shares her favorite under-$100 pieces
headlines.description: I tested clothing and accessories at Walmart to find the best pieces under $100, including workwear, fall jackets, sneakers, boots and bags.

headlines.title: Is It Healthy to Eat Nuts Every Day? Yes, If You Avoid These 3 Things, Dietitians Say
headlines.description: Nuts are delicious, but is it healthy to eat them every day? Dietitians share what to keep in mind if you eat nuts daily and the healthiest types.
